note: A Newark mayoral contest was held on May 11, 2010. The only source for the vote totals is an Internet Archive copy of newarkelection2010.com. That site labels itself Unofficial and carries QLife branding, and no document from an election authority certifies it. The Essex County Clerk page View/30 has no Newark mayor table and says Newark results go to newarkelection2010.com. The archived site shows Booker 22745 and Minor 13570 as the top two, but no official or certified document was found. A search for another source was not completed because the web search budget and the Wayback CDX rate limit were exhausted. The year is left unresolved and no result is recorded.
